title_protection.quote: Using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Doctor of Osteopathy," "Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine," "Physician," "Surgeon," "Physician and Surgeon," "Dr.," "M.D.," "D.O.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition, unless the designation additionally contains the description of or reference to another branch of the healing arts for which the individual holds a valid license in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made false statements or representations to the Board, or willfully concealed material information in connection with a license application, registration, or Board investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made false statements or representations to the Board, or willfully concealed from the Board material information in connection with an application for a license, an application, request or petition for reinstatement or reactivation of a license, an annual registration of a license, or an investigation or inquiry by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or physical or mental abnormality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of material or by reason of any physical or mental abnormality.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including departure from standards of acceptable and prevailing medical practice or ethics of the medical profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, including, but not limited to, departure from, or the failure to conform to, the standards of acceptable and prevailing medical practice, or the ethics of the medical profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in any court of a crime involving moral turpitude, or violation of a law involving the practice of medicine, or a felony conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in any court of a crime involving moral turpitude, or the violation of a law involving the practice of medicine, or a conviction of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: By false representations has obtained or attempted to obtain practice, money or anything of value
disciplinary_grounds.quote: By false representations has obtained or attempted to obtain practice, money or anything of value.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised or publicly professed to treat human ailments under a system or school of treatment other than that for which the physician was educated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised or publicly professed to treat human ailments under a system or school of treatment or practice other than that for which the physician has been educated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of mental incompetency, which shall automatically suspend a license unless the Board orders otherwise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication of mental incompetency, which shall automatically suspend a license unless the Board orders otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lack of professional competence to practice medicine with a reasonable degree of skill and safety for patients or failing to maintain acceptable standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lack of professional competence to practice medicine with a reasonable degree of skill and safety for patients or failing to maintain acceptable standards of care.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Not actively practiced or not maintained continued competency for the two-year period immediately preceding filing of an application for initial or reinstated license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not actively practiced as a licensee, or having not maintained continued competency, as determined by the Board, for the two-year period immediately preceding the filing of an application for an initial license from the Board or the filing of a request, petition, motion, or application to reactivate or reinstate an inactive, suspended, or revoked license previously issued by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods for a patient, or providing services, in a manner that exploits the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods for a patient, or providing services to a patient, in such a manner as to exploit the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, restricted, or acted against or denied by the licensing authority of any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license revoked, suspended, restricted, or acted against or having a license to practice denied by the licensing authority of any jurisdiction, including Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a Board order or failure to respond to Board inquiries concerning any matter affecting the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with an order issued under this Article or the failure to respond, within a reasonable period of time and in a reasonable manner as determined by the Board, to inquiries from the Board concerning any matter affecting the license to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete the required amount of continuing medical education during any three consecutive calendar years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to complete an amount not to exceed 150 hours of continuing medical education during any three consecutive calendar years pursuant to rules adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this Article
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this Article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make reports as required by this Article
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make reports as required by this Article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of Article 1P of Chapter 90 of the General Statutes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of Article 1P of Chapter 90 of the General Statutes, consistent with the provisions of that Article for qualifying licensees.

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine or surgery includes: advertising or holding out as authorized to practice medicine; offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine; offering or undertaking to prevent or diagnose, correct, prescribe for, administer to, or treat in any manner any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition; offering or undertaking to perform any surgical procedure; using the designation 'Doctor,' 'M.D.,' 'D.O.,' etc.; and performing any such act by electronic or other means.
definition_quote.quote: the practice of medicine or surgery, for purposes of this Article, includes any of the following acts: a. Advertising, holding out to the public, or representing in any manner that the individual is authorized to practice medicine in this State. b. Offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other individual. c. Offering or undertaking to prevent or diagnose, correct, prescribe for, administer to, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any individual, including the management of pregnancy or parturition. d. Offering or undertaking to perform any surgical procedure on any individual.

value: treatment of disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition
methods_authorized.quote: Offering or undertaking to prevent or diagnose, correct, prescribe for, administer to, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any individual, including the management of pregnancy or parturition.

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine; may prescribe opioid antagonists directly or by standing order; drug prescribing authority may be delegated to physician assistants and nurse practitioners under supervision.
drug_authority.quote: Offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other individual.

license_status_types.quote: Inactive license. - A license that no longer grants the authorization to perform medical acts, tasks, or functions. A license can become inactive upon a licensee's request, a licensee's failure to register annually, a licensee's voluntary surrender, or based on any disciplinary order issued by the Board.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of international medical schools must have: a currently valid ECFMG certificate, ability to communicate in English, good moral character, two years of postgraduate training in a Board-approved program (or proof of current specialty board certification), and must pass each part of an examination described in G.S. 90-10.1.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: To be eligible for licensure under this section, an applicant who is a graduate of a medical school not approved by the Liaison Commission on Medical Education, the Committee for the Accreditation of Canadian Medical Schools, or the American Osteopathic Association shall submit proof satisfactory to the Board that the applicant has met all of the following: (1) The applicant has successfully completed two years of training in a medical education program approved by the Board after graduation from medical school... (3) The applicant has a currently valid standard certificate of Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: has successfully completed one year of training in a medical education program approved by the Board after graduation from medical school

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: The practice of medicine includes performing acts by use of any electronic or other means, including the internet or telephone; nonregistered physicians in another state may treat their own regular patients temporarily in NC by any method of communication.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The performance of any act, within or without this State, described in this subdivision by use of any electronic or other means, including the internet or telephone.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Appoint two Commissioners to serve on the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Before initiating practice of medical acts, tasks, or functions as a physician assistant, the physician assistant shall provide the Board the name, address, and telephone number of the physician who will supervise the physician assistant in the relevant medical setting.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants are authorized to write prescriptions for drugs subject to Board regulations and supervising physician written instructions; must consult supervising physician before prescribing targeted controlled substances for pain management facilities or use exceeding 30 days.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: Physician assistants are authorized to write prescriptions for drugs under the following conditions: (1) The North Carolina Medical Board has adopted regulations governing the approval of individual physician assistants to write prescriptions with such limitations as the Board may determine to be in the best interest of patient health and safety.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any licensee who does not possess professional liability insurance, or possess professional liability insurance from entities not owned and operated within this State, shall report to the Board any award of damages or any settlement of any malpractice complaint affecting his or her practice within 30 days of the award or settlement.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The chief administrative officer of every licensed hospital or other health care institution...shall, after consultation with the chief of staff of that institution, report to the Board the following actions involving a physician's privileges to practice in that institution within 30 days of the date that the action takes effect

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Board shall refer to the North Carolina Physicians Health Program all licensees whose health and effectiveness have been significantly impaired by alcohol, drug addiction or mental illness.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The Board is empowered and authorized to require an applicant or licensee to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians or physician assistants, or mental examinations by other licensed health care providers acting within the scope of their practice as allowed by law designated by the Board during the pendency of a license application and before or after charges may be presented against the applicant or licensee
